verdict.rationale: Vonage documents server-side archiving through the Media Router: it can "record, save, and retrieve sessions". Sessions can be archived automatically via archive mode, and archive event callbacks are available. Nothing in the pack shows archive files being delivered to a customer-owned storage bucket (e.g. S3 or Azure upload targets). missing for 10: documented delivery of recordings to the developer's own storage bucket, details on archive output format and layout, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: The Media Router supports the archiving feature, which lets you record, save, and retrieve sessions.
When you create a session, you can set the archive mode so that the session is archived automatically.
you can register a callback to monitor events related to Vonage Video archives for your project.
